integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from coordinate summability, Hilbert orthogonality, the parallelogram law, and a one-variable monotonicity calculation. No numerical experiment, database absence, or finite enumeration is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is proved for infinite-index real Hilbert-valued \(\ell_p\) spaces with fibre dimension at least two and \(1\le p<\infty\). Finite index sets for \(p<2\), one-dimensional fibres, arbitrary non-Hilbert fibres, and \(p=\infty\) are not classified.
title: Exact local-octahedrality index of Hilbert-valued \(\ell_p\) sequence spaces
